conbody.p: comes in five variants. E2B and E4B (2B and 4B effective parameters) are for mobile, edge and browser use. The 12B model is a unified multimodal model. The 31B model is dense, and the 26B A4B model is a mixture-of-experts model that activates about 4B parameters per token.
Context length is tokens for the small models and for the medium models.
The card describes the dense and mixture-of-experts designs but does not give the rationale for the design choices.
